top.h1: Tell us the age and the budget. We find the toy.
top.hero-lede: Khelna Bari is a toy shop on Rajdanga Main Road. Toys for babies to 12 year olds, return gifts for birthdays, cycles, school and art things. Every gift wrapped free.

photo.alt: Inside a toy shop: shelves of soft toys, elephants and teddy bears under warm lights

top.p: Pick two things. We send three photos with prices on WhatsApp.

ages.p: Tap an age. These are the toys parents buy most for that age, with today’s example prices.

photo.alt: A baby in a red and orange dress sitting on a mat in a park with a green ball, a toy auto and a blue ride-on car

ages.age-tip: At this ageEverything goes into the mouth. So no small parts, no loose batteries, and colours that are safe to chew.

photo2.alt: A small child in grey dungarees riding a red tricycle on a road

ages.age-tip2: At this ageThey copy what you do. Kitchen sets, doctor sets and anything with wheels are played with every day.

photo3.alt: A heap of plastic building blocks in red, blue, yellow and green

ages.age-tip3: At this ageThey like to build, race and win. Blocks, remote-control cars and simple board games last the longest.

photo4.alt: A Ludo board with red, blue, green and yellow pieces on a wooden floor, a hand reaching for the box

ages.age-tip4: At this ageGames the whole family can play, and kits where they make something on their own.

budget.h2: Going to a birthday this evening?
budget.p: Pick what you want to spend. Each list is in stock most days.

budget.tag-for3: Your own child, niece or nephew
budget.tags-note: Above ₹999 we have cycles, ride-on cars, carrom boards and big remote-control toys. Ask for today’s price.

items.p: Pull-back cars, die-cast cars, race tracks, remote-control cars and trucks.

items.p: Big blocks for small hands, small blocks for big ideas. Bags of 60 to boxes of 500.

items.p: Ludo, snakes and ladders, chess, carrom, word games and jigsaws of 24 to 500 pieces.

items.p: Tricycles, ride-on cars, scooters and cycles of 12, 14, 16 and 20 inch. Fitted free.

photo.alt: An open art case with rows of crayons, sketch pens and water colour cakes

items.p: Crayons, sketch pens, water colours, clay, pencil boxes, bottles and tiffin boxes.

return-gifts.h2: Return gifts in bulk. Price per piece.
return-gifts.p: Buy 10 or more of the same thing and the price drops. The more you take, the less each one costs.

photo.alt: Two hands tying a red ribbon on a small wrapped gift box on a wooden table

return-gifts.p2: One gift or eighty, we wrap each one in paper you choose. No charge. Tell us the number of children and your budget per child.

items.li: You can mix two items (say 15 cars and 15 clay sets). The price is by the total count.
Order 3 days before the party. Pay ₹500 to book, the rest when you collect.
Name sticker on each gift (“Thank you from Riya”): ₹3 per piece.

order.h2: No time to come to the shop? Order on WhatsApp.

items.p: For example: “Girl, 6 years, ₹500.” Add what she likes if you know.
We send three toys with prices. In shop hours, within 15 minutes.
UPI, card at the door, or cash on delivery.
Same day within 3 km. ₹30 delivery, free above ₹799.

safety.h2: What we check before a toy leaves the shop.
safety.p: Child did not like it? Got the same toy twice? Bring it back.

items.p: We stock only toys that carry the mark. Ask us and we show you where it is printed.
We put the cells in and switch the toy on in front of you. If it does not run, it does not get billed.
We read the age on the box and tell you if a toy has small parts not meant for a child under 3.
Check the edges, the wheels and the stitching yourself before you pay.
The art shelf has only colours marked non-toxic on the pack.
Our mechanic fits the cycle, sets the seat to the child’s height and tests both brakes.

items.li: Take any toy of the same price or pay the difference
A toy that stops working in 7 days is replaced
No cash refund; no exchange on clay, crayons and balloons once opened

parents.h22: Asked at the counter every day.
parents.p: Within 3 km of the shop: Kasba, Rajdanga, Bosepukur, Haltu, Ruby and Picnic Garden. Same day if you order before 7 pm. ₹30 per delivery, free above ₹799. Cycles are delivered fitted.
parents.p2: Yes, for every toy bought here, one piece or eighty. You choose the paper. A small gift tag is free too.
parents.p3: Some do. If the box says batteries not included, we tell you before billing and you can add cells at the counter (from ₹20 a pair). Either way we test the toy before it is packed.
parents.p4: Cash, UPI and all cards at the shop. For home delivery: UPI in advance, or cash and UPI at the door.
parents.summary5: Can I exchange a gift someone else bought here?
parents.p5: Yes, if you have the bill or the gift slip we put inside the wrapping, and it is within 7 days.
parents.summary6: Do you repair cycles and remote-control toys?
parents.p6: Cycles bought here get one free service in the first three months. Remote-control toys have a 7 day replacement; after that we can only check the battery and charger.

items.p: Sent my son’s age and a ₹500 budget at 6 in the evening. Three photos came in ten minutes. The wrapped gift reached home before the party at 8.
Took 40 return gifts for my daughter’s birthday. Each one was wrapped, with her name sticker on it. The bill matched the price they told me on the first day.
